subject: social_studies
concept: Writing a research-based policy brief analyzing a real global affairs issue and proposing a balanced approach, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a policy brief using a background/interests/options/recommendation organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a policy brief on a real global affairs issue, presenting multiple perspectives before proposing an approach

assessment.mastery_threshold: brief presents multiple genuine perspectives before making a reasoned recommendation
misconception_flags: brief presents only one perspective and states a recommendation with no engagement with opposing views

interest_binding: issue generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
